records.content: In 2016, Barack Obama asked whether — if you did not know who you would be — you would choose to be born now rather than in an earlier decade. This book uses long-running survey data (mainly the GSS and ANES) to take that question seriously topic by topic: race, sexual orientation, gender, religion, and related themes.

Teaching notebooks that walk through the period-only and period–cohort models used in the book. Open either link to run on Google Colab:

Period-only models — national trend over survey years (linear logit → RW1 → RW2 → RW2 with overdispersion), using GSS attitudes toward same-sex relations

Period–cohort models — additive period–cohort surface and decade-specific period trends on the same outcome
